method: Prices and plan terms are collected from official vendor sources. The catalog snapshot date applies to the merged file; source_checked_at and source_receipts record newer per-plan checks. Ordinary HTTPS fetches are used when available. OpenAI Help Center price statements were read through the official web renderer after ordinary HTTPS returned 403; no access controls were bypassed. Numeric task quotas are never inferred from plan prices or relative usage multipliers. See the linked source receipts and each vendor pricing URL.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.quote: Non-commercial use only. You agree that you will not use our Services for any commercial or business purposes …
anthropic.quote_note: EEA/Switzerland consumer terms, effective 2025-10-08 (the version served to our location).

google.name: Google
google.quote: Only personal Google Accounts can sign up for Google AI plans. Workspace customers can sign up for a Gemini add-on to their existing subscription.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.quote_note: Pricing was checked 2026-09-24 in official OpenAI Help Center pages via the official web renderer because plain HTTPS returned 403. Numeric task quotas and business-use terms were not verified.

xai.name: xAI
xai.quote_note: The official pricing page was reachable by ordinary HTTPS and rechecked 2026-09-24. It lists SuperGrok at $30/month; numeric quotas are not published there. The terms page was not rechecked, so business-use status remains unclear.

github.name: GitHub
github.quote: GitHub Copilot Individual is designed for individual developers, freelancers, students, educators, and open source maintainers.
github.quote_note: Organisations are steered to Copilot Business/Enterprise; no outright prohibition was found.

cursor.quote: If you are entering into these Terms on behalf of an entity, you represent that you have the legal authority to bind that entity.
